top_signals.title: Eight petroleum liquids pipeline projects have been completed since the start of 2025
top_signals.summary: In the 2026 release of our Liquids Pipeline Projects Database, we tracked the completion of 8 liquid fuels pipeline projects since the start of 2025, and an additional 14 new projects have been announced.
